# smart-immunizations-docs

The reader-facing pages, and the landing page `/smart-immunizations/` serves. Generated by `smart-immunizations:pages` (`fhir-harness/scripts/gen-ig-pages.ts --summary`) from `fhir-artifact-index/index.json`: the instance's own harness section, then every artefact with its canonical URL, published representations and sidecars. The index page declares itself the `fhir-artifact-index` viewer (`rendered-by: ig-pages`). WHY: until stage C of #1767 this IG's artefact index had no published viewer at all. NOTHING HERE IS AUTHORED; `smart-immunizations:pages:check` is the gate.

Part of [smart-immunizations](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-immunizations-docs`, holding `docs`.
